goal: UR10 + surface_gripper picks one cube off a stationary feeder and delivers it onto a FLAT OPEN low platform (no walls, no belt motion) instead of a deep bin or a stack-target. Authored as the clean STAGE-0 of a robot-diversity sequential chain (#29): the flat platform is a pickable handoff surface a Franka stage-1 can grab from with a free top-down grip. Standalone it is a UR10 cuRobo+suction pick-place that delivers 1/1.
thoughts:
Flat-platform handoff design (vs CP-70 deep Bin / CP-84 BaseCube stack-target):
1) UR10 base on table at (0,0,0.75) + suction on ee_link — same proven CP-70 controller path (cuRobo + surface_gripper, function-gate verified, raycast workaround).
2) Stationary FEEDER at (-0.5,0.4,0.78) carries one cube into the UR10 pick zone (surface_velocity 0.001 = effectively static, the CP-70 feeder pattern).
3) DELIVERY TARGET = a FLAT OPEN platform (create_conveyor with surface_velocity=[0,0,0]). create_conveyor with zero velocity yields a single static collidable kinematic Cube — a flat slab with NO walls and NO belt motion. This is the whole point: a deep bin (5 walls) blocks a downstream pick (cuRobo no-plan-into-walls + PhysX grip-vs-wall blow-up); a BaseCube stack-target is a colliding prop a downstream conveyor overlaps; a FLAT slab is freely pickable top-down.
4) Platform top surface z = 0.78 + 0.04/2 = 0.80 (a 0.04m-thick slab centred at z=0.78). The delivered cube rests centred on the slab top at z ~ 0.825 (slab top 0.80 + half cube 0.025) — exactly table-top pick height, in the downstream Franka's z-window.
5) Platform placed at (0.5,-0.4,0.78) — INSIDE UR10 reach (1.20m), clear of the feeder, on a flat open part of the table. drop_target=[0.5,-0.4,0.825] drops the cube onto the slab top centre. planning_obstacles include the platform so cuRobo plans down to the top surface without colliding.
6) Distinct delivery footprint: the platform is a SLAB the downstream stage-1 Franka can reach with no overlapping pick structure (the chained Franka in CP-NEW-franka-flat-receive has NO conveyor) — this reconciles the cont.184 COMMON ROOT (stage0-delivery-surface vs stage1-pick-structure).
code:
# Toolified opening [P2-07]: light + ground + cell + table + physics in ONE call
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[3.0, 1.0])

# UR10 spawned via robot_wizard (applies home_joints, ee_link)
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="ur10",
    dest_path="/World/UR10",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[1, 0, 0, 0],
)

# Suction gripper attached to UR10's ee_link (CP-70 proven path)
surface_gripper(
    robot_path="/World/UR10",
    ee_link="/World/UR10/ee_link",
    grip_threshold=0.02,
    force_limit=200.0,
    torque_limit=200.0,
)

# Stationary feeder (verifier bridge for the source cube)
create_conveyor(
    prim_path="/World/Feeder",
    position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.78],
    size=[0.40, 0.30, 0.05],
    surface_velocity=[0.001, 0, 0],
)

# Single cube on feeder
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# FLAT OPEN delivery platform: create_conveyor with surface_velocity=[0,0,0]
# = a single static collidable kinematic Cube slab, NO walls, NO motion.
# Top surface z = 0.78 + 0.04/2 = 0.80. Placed inside UR10 reach, clear of feeder.
create_conveyor(
    prim_path="/World/HandoffPad",
    position=[0.5, -0.4, 0.78],
    size=[0.40, 0.40, 0.04],
    surface_velocity=[0, 0, 0],
)

# Pick sensor on the feeder pick zone
add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[-0.4, 0.4, 0.835], size=[0.10, 0.06, 0.06])

# UR10 cuRobo controller — delivers onto the flat pad top centre
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/UR10",
    robot_family="ur10",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/Feeder",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/HandoffPad",
    drop_target=[0.5, -0.4, 0.825],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/Feeder", "/World/HandoffPad"],
)
extension_notes: CP-NEW-ur10-flat-deliver = CP-70 with the deep Bin replaced by a FLAT OPEN platform (HandoffPad: create_conveyor with surface_velocity=[0,0,0] -> static collidable slab, no walls, no motion). This makes the delivery surface PICKABLE by a downstream Franka stage-1 (top-down/suction grip with no wall blow-up), which a deep bin (CP-70) or a stack-target BaseCube (CP-84) is not. Authored for #29 robot-diversity sequential chain: pair with CP-NEW-franka-flat-receive as stage-1.
failure_modes: Same UR10+suction integration path as CP-70 (function-gate verified there): SurfaceGripper schema, ee_link path, cuRobo+suction coordination. No new robot-side risk.

Drop precision onto the flat pad: if cuRobo's descent ends ~0.02m high the cube tumbles a little but stays on the 0.40x0.40 slab (large landing area vs a 0.05 cube). xy_tolerance=0.12 in simulate_args covers it.

Platform is a kinematic rigid body (create_conveyor applies kinematicEnabled=True) with zero surface velocity — it does NOT push the delivered cube (verified: surfaceVelocity=[0,0,0] disables the integrator's push). It just provides a flat collision surface.

In a chain, stage-0's HandoffPad becomes the stage-1 pick surface ONLY if stage-1's pick zone overlaps the pad world position — handled by the chain offset (see chain usage note), not a standalone failure.
verified_status: build-spec-2026-06-17; STANDALONE function-gate EXPECTED pass (CP-70 controller path, flat target easier than deep bin); CHAIN stage-0 untested (human-serial Kit run required).
